sloka: तस्य तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा राज पुत्रस्य धीमतः ।अब्रवीत् प्रान्जलिर् वाक्यम् गुहो गहन गोचरः ॥२-८५-५॥
transliteration: tasya tat vacanam śrutvā rāja putrasya dhīmataḥ ।abravīt prānjalir vākyam guho gahana gocaraḥ ॥2-85-5॥

translations.english: When he heard those words of the sagacious Bharata, Guha the forest ranger answered him reverentially with folded palms.
